6. ACKNOWLEDGEMENT

Dr. R. Addison kindly commented on a draft of the report and
supervised the final preparation and submission. His assistance

is appreciated and gratefully acknowledged.

Thanks are also due to the G.C.0. Typing Pool for preparing draft
and final typescripts, and to Geological Survey Section technical
staff, particularly W.Y. Wong and P.C. Kam, for redrafting some of
the figures and for their cheerful assistance with this and the
other reports by the writer, prepared in accordance with the

requirements of the Consultancy Agreement.
